Package com.ceichhorst.reservation.entity

Class ReservationAction

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.ceichhorst.reservation.entity.ReservationAction
  • @Entity
public class ReservationAction
extends Object
    Entity representing an audit log entry for an administrative action performed on a Reservation.

    Each ReservationAction records:

    • The reservation affected
    • The administrator who performed the action
    • The type of action taken
    • The timestamp when the action occurred

    This entity supports reservation auditing and administrative history tracking, allowing the system to maintain a chronological record of changes such as:

    • Reservation confirmations
    • Reservation cancellations
    • Reservation updates or edits

    Each action is automatically timestamped when persisted using the PrePersist lifecycle callback.

    This entity maps to the reservation_action table in the reservation platform database.
